name: Oltec
description: Allies of the warriors at the plane's core.

description_citations.text: "Wayta". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A fungal outbreak strikes Topizielo in the Ixalan caverns, the beginning of the mycoids.
timeline.quote: an outbreak struck Topizielo

citation.text: "Fungus", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Komon and Oltec humans flee the caverns for the surface, while those who remain seal off the Core.
timeline.quote: The Komon and Oltec in the caverns fled, finding safety outside of the caverns.

citation.text: "Fungus", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hundreds of thousands of Komon Winaq migrate to the surface, later becoming the Sun Empire, while those who stay become the Oltec.
timeline.quote: Those who stayed behind began to call themselves Oltec .

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "First Exodus". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A fungal outbreak at Topizielo spawns the mycoids, which overrun the caverns; the Oltec seal the Core's entrances.
timeline.quote: Those who remained in the caverns sealed all entrances to the Core to protect it from the spread of the mycoids.

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Birth of the Mycotyrant". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Figures above the well notice that the seal has been opened and call for Anim Pakal.
timeline.quote: Someone has opened the seal.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The vampire abominations attack the Oltec bat riders and the great battle begins.
timeline.quote: The vampire abominations flew toward the Oltec force.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The second Sun Empire delegation reaches Oteclan to find Chimil restored while pyres burn.
timeline.quote: The second Sun Empire delegation reached Oteclan a week after the battle, to find Chimil restored to her previous glory even as pyres of the dead burned.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Brazen Coalition explorers find the Oltec unimpressed by cannons.
timeline.quote: To their dismay, Brazen Coalition explorers soon found that the Oltec were not impressed by cannons.

citation.text: Dauntless Dismantler (The Lost Caverns of Ixalan, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Malamet and Oltec find a common enemy in the mycoids and begin sharing glyph knowledge.
timeline.quote: the Malamet and the Oltec found a common enemy in the mycoids.

citation.text: Envoy of Okinec Ahau (The Lost Caverns of Ixalan, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Oltec sealed the Core off from the world under siege from the Mycotyrant, until Huatli's party arrived.
timeline.quote: Centuries ago, under siege from the Mycotyrant, the Oltec sealed the Core off from the world... until Huatli's party arrived.

citation.text: The Core (The Lost Caverns of Ixalan, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Oltec citizens rally to the Thousand Moons as the Legion of Dusk closes in.
timeline.quote: As the Legion of Dusk closed in, Oltec citizens rallied to support the Thousand Moons and drive off the invaders.

citation.text: Sunshot Militia (The Lost Caverns of Ixalan, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Oltec retreat into the Core to safeguard their knowledge and cosmium.
timeline.quote: who retreated into the Core to safeguard their knowledge and cosmium

citation.text: "Caverns of Ixalan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Oltec seal the Core with Matzalantli, cutting off travel between surface and depths.
timeline.quote: the Oltec sealed the Core using Matzalantli

citation.text: "Caverns of Ixalan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Coin Empire's invasion, Chimil was caged and freed only after 320 years of darkness when the Oltec attacked; she destroyed her prison.
timeline.quote: After an invasion by the Coin Empire , she was caged by their invasion ships

citation.text: "Chimil", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Coin Empire invades Ixalan's Core, turns on the Oltec and cages Chimil in an assembly of ships.
timeline.quote: eventually caging the inner sun Chimil within an assembly of their invasion ships

citation.text: "Coin Empire", section "Invasion of Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After a 320-year Night War, Chimil destroys its prison.
timeline.quote: This went on for 320 years

citation.text: "Coin Empire", section "Invasion of Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Saheeli tells Quint of evidence beneath Orazca; he joins the expedition to the Core and meets the Oltec.
timeline.quote: Quint joined the expedition to the Core of Ixalan

citation.text: "Coin Empire", section "Rediscovery". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A fungal outbreak at Topizielo spreads through the caverns, giving rise to the mycoids, and the Core is sealed.
timeline.quote: Those who remained in the caverns sealed all entrances to the Core to protect it from the spread of the mycoids.

citation.text: "Core of Paradise", section "Birth of the Mycotyrant". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk frees Aclazotz, who tries to snuff out the inner sun, while the Mycotyrant attacks the Oltec; both are defeated but escape to the surface.
timeline.quote: The latter faction freed Aclazotz , who then attempted to snuff out the plane's inner sun.

citation.text: "Core of Paradise", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After 320 years of darkness, the Oltec attack the colonizers and Chimil destroys her prison.
timeline.quote: After 320 years of darkness, the Oltec launched a final attack against the colonizers

citation.text: "Cosmium", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk frees Aclazotz, who tries to snuff out the inner sun, while the Mycotyrant attacks the Oltec; both are defeated but escape to the surface.
timeline.quote: The latter faction freed Aclazotz, who then attempted to snuff out the plane's inner sun.

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Rediscovery of the Core". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The first humans awaken inside the Core of Paradise and understand Chimil as their creator, becoming the Komon Winaq.
timeline.quote: Humans stood to their full height under Chimil and understood her to be their creator.

citation.text: "Oltec", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cults of Aclazotz form and fight back against the elders, spreading violence across the Core.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz's cults fought back, and the fields and cities of the Komon Winaq raged with violence.

citation.text: "Oltec", section "The Whispering War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Coin Empire invades the Core, blots out Chimil's light and cages her in a metal prison.
timeline.quote: They blotted out the light of Chimil and then caged her within a metal prison.

citation.text: "Oltec", section "Age of the Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chimil shatters the Fomori prison and cosmium blasts away the Fomori, creating the first angels of Ixalan; the Deep Gods return.
timeline.quote: Cosmium lashed out from Chimil, blasting away the Fomori while innervating the Komon

citation.text: "Oltec", section "Night War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Some Komon Winaq go to the surface and become the Sun Empire; those who stay become the Oltec.
timeline.quote: Some of the Komon Winaq traveled to the plane's surface, later becoming the Sun Empire.

citation.text: "Oltec", section "The Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Contact between the Oltec and Sun Empire is sealed off because of the spread of the mycoids.
timeline.quote: They maintained regular trade with the Oltec until the spread of the mycoids forced the two to seal off contact.

citation.text: "Oltec", section "The Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Quiet Age the Oltec repair Night War damage and expand into unexplored parts of the Core.
timeline.quote: During the Quiet Age, there was very little conflict between groups and no war.

citation.text: "Oltec", section "The Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Oltec imprison the vampires; Vito escapes violently and sets out to find Aclazotz.
timeline.quote: Vito engineered a violent escape

citation.text: "Queen's Bay Company", section "To Ixalan's Core". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vito feeds kidnapped Oltec to Aclazotz, who breaks his bindings and blesses Vito and his followers, turning them into batlike demons.
timeline.quote: he fed these people to the ancient god, who broke his bindings

citation.text: "Queen's Bay Company", section "To Ixalan's Core". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Oltec imprison the vampires; Vito engineers a violent escape.
timeline.quote: Vito engineered a violent escape

citation.text: "Vito Quijano de Pasamonte", section "Freeing Aclazotz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vito feeds kidnapped Oltec to Aclazotz, who breaks free and turns Vito and followers into demons.
timeline.quote: he fed these people to the ancient god, who broke his bindings.

citation.text: "Vito Quijano de Pasamonte", section "Freeing Aclazotz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Oltec capture and reverse-engineer gnome technology from the Coin Empire at the end of the Night War.
timeline.quote: when they captured and reverse-engineered the technology to create them from the Coin Empire

citation.text: "Gnome", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Oltec fight off the Mycotyrant with spirits in the Core while Breeches explodes its nexus, killing subordinate mycoids.
timeline.quote: Breeches managed to explode its nexus with a powerful firearm

citation.text: "Mycotyrant", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion, entrances to the Core are discovered and factions converge on Matzalantli.
timeline.quote: entrances to the plane's Core were discovered across the surface of Ixalan

citation.text: "Reopening of Ixalan's Core", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz transforms followers into batlike demons to extinguish Chimil while the Mycotyrant assaults the Oltec.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz transformed his followers into batlike demons

citation.text: "Reopening of Ixalan's Core", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Wayta joins the expedition from Orazca to the plane's core and fights Aclazotz, Vito and the bat-demons with the Oltec.
timeline.quote: the warriors battled Aclazotz

citation.text: "Wayta", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
